'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Mark Peterson LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title They ARE on Dantooine!


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Peterson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|Dantooine Base Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
